newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Bompreco still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Bompreco still a buy.

text.p: -- Robert Flemings said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian supermarket chain Bompreco.

-- It also said it had raised its 1998 estimated sales and net income forecasts for Bompreco following the group's acquisition of Supermar Supermercados, a supermarket chain located in Salvador in northeastern state of Bahia.
--- "This implies that Supermar will contribute net income of 5.7 million reais in 1998 on sales of roughly 715.7 million reais," it said.
-- Supermar's operations complement Bompreco's existing operations, which include 40 supermarkets and 10 hypermarkets, it added.
